batch: P6 backfill 2026-11-13: audit indexes 75-258 (80 previously pending URLs)
notes: All 80 older pending website entries have been reviewed. Current master venue inventory now has zero pending rows with Website_URL, but 742 entries are explicitly queued for other-source discovery because they lack actionable websites.

27 new January occurrences are projections from officially published weekly or monthly named programmes; none has been individually announced by an operator for January 2027. Recheck closures, holidays and one-off changes before promotion.

The venue flagged as permanently closed is Sauna Babylonia Prague (PRG-SAU-01). Its older indexed homepage still shows obsolete weekly party copy; newer official indexed closure notice and a 1 Sep 2026 LUI report confirm closure. No events created. listings.json was not modified.
Mixed-audience events excluded, particularly Sauna69 Friday Gender Free events and general Pride parties.
Already present Pullermanns Bear Bash event 2027-01-22 was retained without duplication.
Event descriptions clearly label the projected dates rather than misrepresenting them as independently announced.
